title: Number of Pairs of Strings With Concatenation Equal to Target
goal: Count ordered pairs of distinct indices whose strings concatenate to target.
strategy: Split target at every nonempty boundary. Multiply the frequencies of the two pieces; if both pieces are identical, exclude choosing the same index twice.
